newsitem.title: USA: Texaco diesel-unit back over weekend - source.
newsitem.headline: Texaco diesel-unit back over weekend - source.

text.p: A diesel-making unit at Texaco Inc's Washington state refinery ran at reduced capacity Thursday but will likely return to normal rates over the weekend, sources said.
The 25,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) hydrotreater scaled back production mid-week. The cause of the problem was unknown, sources said.

The unit is part Texaco's 135,000 bpd plant on the Puget Sound in Washington. "I was told it would be a three to four day problem," beginning on Wednesday, an industry source said. "It was a small problem, with no fire or explosion."
Texaco officials decline comment on refinery operations.
